test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The length, width and height of a cuboid are in the ratio 10 : 17 : 14, and its total surface area is 1096 cm². Find the length (in cm) of the cuboid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **length** : **width** : **height** = 10 : 17 : 14

Let common factor be x. Then **TSA** = 2(10x×17x + 17x×14x + 14x×10x) = 1096

⇒ 2(170x² + 238x² + 140x²) = 1096 ⇒ 548x² = 548 ⇒ x = 1

**Length** = 10 × 1 = 10 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of **dimensions** = 10 : 17 : 14, **Total Surface Area** = 1096 cm²

**Formula Used:** Total Surface Area of **Cuboid** = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/724a924f38491741174c6e71d9f363d6df99ede647c051eca8595ec5bd13e8e2.png] 

⇒ Let l = 10x, b = 17x, and h = 14x

⇒ 2[(10x × 17x) + (17x × 14x) + (14x × 10x)] = 1096

⇒ 2[170x² + 238x² + 140x²] = 1096

⇒ 2[548x²] = 1096

⇒ 1096x² = 1096

⇒ x² = 1 ⇒ x = 1

⇒ **Length** = 10 × 1 = 10 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by a cuboid is calculated as Length × Width × Height (l × b × h).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid is √(l² + b² + h²).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side walls is given by the formula 2h(l + b).</p
